subject: Verivaro P0-A independent recovery-floor authority acquisition test contract

requirements.name: Independent governance and signer custody
requirements.simulatedEvidence: Pinned Ed25519 policy and authority key roles are checked locally
requirements.externalProof: Buyer-controlled independent IdP, hardware/managed key lifecycle, separation-of-duties and revocation-authority audit

requirements.name: Atomic floor and revocation ordering
requirements.simulatedEvidence: Synchronous in-memory policy and floor transitions reject stale checkpoints
requirements.externalProof: Authenticated authority persists floor, signer revocations and policy high-water mark in one tested linearizable commit

requirements.name: Cross-host write fencing
requirements.simulatedEvidence: Simulated writer epochs reject stale holders and parallel replay
requirements.externalProof: Two or more separately hosted writers and quorum-fenced leases under actual competing processes and partitions

requirements.name: Partition and acknowledgement ambiguity
requirements.simulatedEvidence: Simulated pre-commit partitions reject requests and lost ACK cannot reset committed floor
requirements.externalProof: Measured off-host network partition, lost-ACK, stale replica and reconnect behaviour without duplicate commits

requirements.name: Independent trusted time and receipt freshness
requirements.simulatedEvidence: Nonce-bound v2 receipts and bounded synthetic UTC clock values
requirements.externalProof: Authenticated clock provenance, skew thresholds, monotonic time controls and verified expiry across hosts

requirements.name: Recovery after physical power loss
requirements.simulatedEvidence: Single-host process-exit and full-capacity fixture recovery checks
requirements.externalProof: Power-cut tests on independent hardware, encrypted off-site backup restore with measured RTO/RPO and tamper logs

requirements.name: Independent monotonic rollback floor
requirements.simulatedEvidence: Local hash chain, pinned checkpoint and simulated revision monotonicity
requirements.externalProof: Non-rollbackable separate operator storage of serial/head/logHash/policy checkpoint and adversarial restore drills

requirements.name: Acquisition handover and rights
requirements.simulatedEvidence: Public code, synthetic export, evidence manifest and dependency metadata inventory
requirements.externalProof: Independent source/IP assignment, licensing notices, buyer install, product usability assessment and validated willingness to pay
